description: Find a cruise by departure port, party size, month, and total budget, returning deep links into Pixie Vacations' online cruise booking engine (no fees). Ideal for 'family cruise from Florida under $X' style requests. For Virgin Voyages or river cruises, prefer search_virgin_voyages or get_river_cruise_info.

departure_port.description: e.g. Miami, Port Canaveral, Fort Lauderdale, Tampa, Galveston

max_total_budget.description: total budget for the whole party, e.g. $6000

name: find_cruise
